subject: Neha Kapoor - exit coordination & customer coverage
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount decision: immediate separation (Neha Kapoor)

Team,

After today's review and a documented performance improvement follow-up, leadership has approved an immediate involuntary separation for Neha Kapoor effective today. Markus has signed the termination authorization (attached).

Immediate asks:
- HR (Laura): please prepare a severance offer and final paycheck calculation (PTO, bonuses if any) and route for signature. We’d prefer a short, standard package: 8 weeks base + COBRA offering, but open to HR/legal guidance.
- Security (Vivek): disable SSO and admin privileges now, revoke API keys and rotate any customer credentials Neha had access to. BrightScale is an active customer; coordinate key rotation and confirm no running jobs will be impacted.
- Ops/Facilities: arrange for laptop pickup or courier (see equipment pickup form).
- Communications: Stephanie, please prepare a concise customer message for BrightScale (do not include reasons; simply state contact reassignment).

Laura, Vivek — can you confirm timeline? I’ve attached the signed authorization.

Thanks,
Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: termination_authorization.pdf (PDF)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount decision: immediate separation (Neha Kapoor)

Markus / team —

Thanks for the heads up. I’m attaching a draft severance agreement (severance_offer_neha_v1.pdf) and the equipment pickup checklist. Proposed economic terms in the draft: 8 weeks base pay, continuation of health benefits for 60 days (COBRA packet included), and outplacement assistance voucher. If leadership wants a different amount, let me know ASAP.

Next steps I’ll action once you confirm:
- Generate DocuSign envelope and send to Neha for signature (or route to her counsel if requested).
- Initiate final payroll with finance (include PTO payout).
- Schedule laptop pickup (we can do same-day courier if Neha is remote).
- Prepare HR exit letter and benefits summary.

Question: Do we want Neha to be placed on leave of absence pending paperwork or removed immediately from calendar invites? Common practice is to suspend calendar visibility and routing while allowing final conversations. Advise.

Laura Bennett
Senior HR Business Partner
Redwood Inference
Attachment: severance_offer_neha_v1.pdf (PDF); equipment_pickup_form.pdf (PDF)
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount decision: immediate separation (Neha Kapoor)

Laura / Markus / Stephanie —

Planned remediation steps and timing (I’ll coordinate with CloudOps):
1) Immediate: disable Neha’s SSO and SSH access (completed at 11:25).
2) Within 2 hours: revoke all API keys associated with her account and rotate service account credentials for jobs touched by her.
3) Within 24 hours: rotate BrightScale-related keys and update their integration. I will engage itops@cloudops.io to perform the rotation; they will require a maintenance window (we should keep BrightScale in the loop).
4) Confirm laptop full-disk encryption status before pickup. If decrypted, treat as potential data incident and escalate.

Please avoid sending a customer-facing note that includes operational details (e.g., "removed access") — the external note should be limited to a contact reassignment. I’ll post timestamps to this thread as actions complete.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Katie Miller <katie.miller@brightscale.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Jul 2025 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Account contact update — BrightScale (was: Neha Kapoor)

Katie —

Quick note to let you know that Neha is no longer with Redwood. We are assigning interim coverage to ensure no interruption to BrightScale’s account: Markus Klein will be the primary point of contact until we confirm a permanent rep, and I’ll be handling day-to-day communications for any open items.

Action items for BrightScale (if any):
- If you have recurring meetings with Neha, please keep them on the calendar for now — Markus or I will step in.
- If there are access or integration issues, please reply directly to this thread and cc itops@cloudops.io. Vivek will coordinate any credential rotations.

We appreciate your patience while we transition.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Customer Success Manager, Enterprise Accounts

Subject: Final severance agreement & logistics (Neha Kapoor)

Neha —

Please find the finalized severance package in DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/rooms/neha-severance-2025. Key points: 8 weeks salary continuation, COBRA packet attached for enrollment, and a courier pickup scheduled for your company laptop. Payroll vendor Alan at PayrollHub is looped to process final pay and PTO payout upon DocuSign completion.

Next steps (please complete ASAP):
- Review and sign the DocuSign envelope.
- Confirm a pickup address for the laptop (use the equipment_pickup_form.pdf attached to this thread).

If you prefer to review with counsel, let us know and we’ll extend the signing window.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior HR Business Partner

Subject: Exit checklist completed (Neha Kapoor)

Team —

Quick status update: all items below completed unless noted.
- Termination authorization signed (Markus) — done.
- Severance DocuSign sent (Laura) — pending Neha signature.
- SSO & SSH disabled (Vivek) — done 2025-07-01 11:25 PDT.
- API keys revoked + BrightScale rotation — itops engaged; rotation scheduled 2025-07-02 18:00 PDT.
- Laptop pickup scheduled (FedEx) — collection set for 2025-07-03 between 10a-2p.
- Customer notification sent to BrightScale (Stephanie) — done.

Outstanding: Neha’s DocuSign signature and final payroll confirmation from PayrollHub (Alan). Laura, once signed, please confirm and mark thread closed.

Thanks everyone for the quick coordination.
Markus
